Cup. All hail Bas de Leede." 
Bas de Leede, Player of the Match: "We had a look at the targets, where we wanted to be 
at the halfway point. Maxy and Vikram set the platform for the rest of us to finish it. The 
rate was 10 to 11 runs per over, so we had to go to the T20 mode, try as many runs as 
we could and see where it would take us. It's amazing, can't describe the feeling, it's 
going to be one big party tonight 
Sampath Bandarupalli chimes that Bas de Leede is only the fourth player to score a 
century and take a five-wicket haul in the same men's ODI 
Richie Berrington, Scotland Captain: "Yeah, that's obviously a really tough one to take 
today. The guys will certainly be be hurting right now. I'm extremely proud of the guys 
for the fight we showed throughout this tournament. Unfortunately, today wasn't quite 
enough also have to give credit to their guys, the way they played. I think we probably 
just maybe weren't as disciplined as we have been through the tournament. They run 
really well between the wickets. But again, yeah, we probably just missed the mark a 
little bit. Obviously, it was a different sort of wicket. As we saw in the first Innings, it's 
been a couple of games played in this surface so it wasn't as much swing today. So it's 
slightly different tactics. Yeah, maybe through that middle stage, we slid away from 
those plans which just sort of got them back into the game. Yeah, like obviously it's a 
really tough one but I think looking over the whole tournament, we can be very proud of 
some of the cricket we've played. And certainly some good building blocks, we can keep 
improving. A lot of different players stepped up at different times throughout this 
tournament, which has been really exciting to see and some young players coming into 
the squad as well. They've done really well. So that's good signs for the future" 
Scott Edwards, Netherlands Captain: "Extremely (happy), yeah. Little bit loss for words. I 
thought what Bas de Leede and Zulfiqar did in the last 10 overs was unbelievable to 
watch. This group is just incredible. We put in the hard work and the guys just enjoy 
everyone's success. We had a different match-winner in every game. It's a pretty 
awesome feeling. It was just unbelievable batting by Leede and Saqib in the end. Cook 
brought the batting group together at the halfway point, the white board had 140 at 26 
overs, we were maybe 15-20 behind. We knew what we wanted to do; we just needed a 
couple of batters to cash in towards the backend. Leede got five wickets and 123; he is 
an unbelievable player, we have always known that everyone is aware of that. It's not the 
first time he has done it and it won't be the last."
